notablePrerequisites:
Altered Ego on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Altered Ego do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Altered Ego.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Altered Ego.
Activate Altered Ego by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Altered Ego ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
